#### Genetic Management of White River Spring (WRS) Chinook Salmon

#### Ancestry Model

#### WRS NOR & Baseline (WRS + Green River Fall)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

name_repair <-
  function(names){
    names <- 
      tolower(names) |>
      gsub(pattern="[^A-Za-z0-9_%]+", replacement="_") |> 
      gsub(pattern="%", replacement="percent", fixed=TRUE)
    is_dup <- 
      names %in% names[duplicated(names)]
    if(any(is_dup)){
      suffixes <- 
        ave(names, names, FUN=function(x) paste0("_", seq_along(x)))
      names[is_dup] <- 
        paste0(names[is_dup], suffixes[is_dup])}
    return(names)}

r25 <- 
  read_excel(
    path="../data-from-Amelia/2025_WhiteRiverHatcherySpringChinook_GenotypingReport.xlsx", 
    .name_repair=name_repair, 
    na="NA")

r26 <- 
  read_excel(
    path="../data-from-Amelia/2026_WhiteRiverHatcherySpringChinook_GenotypingReport.xlsx", 
    .name_repair=name_repair, 
    na="NA")

r09_24 <- 
  read_excel(
    path="../White River NOR Chinook DNA Data 2009 to 2024.xlsx", 
    .name_repair=name_repair, 
    na="NA") |> 
  mutate(date=as.numeric(date) |> as.Date(origin="1899-12-30"))

rdat <- 
  bind_rows(r09_24, r25, r26)

rdat$lh <- 
  rdat$sex

rdat$sex <- 
  replace_values(
    rdat$sex,
    "f" ~ "F", 
    c("m", "J") ~ "M")

rdat$lh <- 
  replace_values(
    rdat$lh,
    c("f", "F", "m", "M") ~ "adult", 
    "J" ~ "jack")

rdat$assignment <- 
  replace_values(
    rdat$assignment,
    "Unassigned" ~ "Unknown")

baseline <- 
  read_tsv(
    "../data-from-Amelia/Updated_WhiteRiverChinookBaseline_RubiasInput.txt", 
    col_types=str_flatten(rep("c", 594)), 
    na="NA",
    name_repair=name_repair)

baseline <- 
  reduce(
    names(baseline) |> 
      grep("^ots\\w+_[12]$", x=_, value=TRUE) |> 
      sub("_[12]$", "", x=_) |> 
      unique(),
    \(df, prefix){
      unite(
        df,
        col=!!prefix,
        matches(paste0("^", prefix, "_[12]$")),
        sep="",
        na.rm=TRUE)},
    .init=baseline) |>
  mutate(across(5:299, ~ na_if(., "")))


nor <- 
  read_csv(
    "../data-from-Amelia/WhiteRiver_NORGenotypeData_2021_2026.csv", 
    na="0", 
    name_repair=name_repair) |> 
  rename(id=sample_name)

dat <- 
  bind_rows(rename(baseline, id=indiv), nor) |> 
  select(-sample_type, -year)

gdat <- 
  select(dat, -299:-331, -335) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(prop=sum(across(4:301, ~!is.na(.)))/298) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  relocate(prop, .after=id) |> 
  filter(prop>=0.75)

gdat <- 
  left_join(x=gdat, y=rename(rdat, id=wdfw_id)) |> 
  relocate(303:317, .after=id) |> 
  filter(is.na(comment)) |>
  select(-genotypingsuccess, -comment) |> 
  mutate(year=ifelse(is.na(year), yes=(str_extract(string=id, pattern="^\\d{2}") |> as.numeric())+2000, no=year))

gdat$year <- 
  replace_values(gdat$year, 2098 ~ 1998)

gdat <- 
  arrange(gdat, year, id)

gdat <- 
  mutate(
    gdat, 
    collection=ifelse(
      test=is.na(collection), 
      yes=paste("White_River_Chinook_at_Buckley_Trap", assignment, str_extract(string=id, pattern="^\\w{4}"), sep="_"), 
      no=collection) |> 
      gsub(pattern="@", replacement="at", fixed=TRUE), 
    length=if_else(condition=length>100, true=length/10, false=length))


collnames <- 
  table(gdat$collection, useNA="ifany") |> 
  names()

gdat <- 
  mutate(gdat, collection=factor(collection))

gdat$collection <- 
  factor(
    gdat$collection, 
    levels=collnames[c(3, 23, 7:8, 17:22, 24:29, 9:14, 4, 6, 2, 5, 1)], 
    ordered=TRUE)

gdat <- 
  arrange(gdat, collection, id)

gdat <- 
  distinct(gdat, id, .keep_all=TRUE) |> 
  filter(!is.na(collection))


gsnps <- 
  enframe(colSums(!is.na(gdat[18:315]))/nrow(gdat)) |> 
  filter(value < 1) |> 
  filter(value >= 0.75)

gdatw <- 
  select(gdat, collection, id, gsnps$name) |> 
  separate_wider_position(cols=3:254, widths=c(a1=1, a2=1), names_sep="_")


gdatw <- 
  rename(gdatw, pop=collection, ID=id) |> 
  mutate(PaternalID=0, MaternalID=0, Sex=0, Phenotype=1) |> 
  relocate(507:510, .after=ID)

gdatw$pop <- 
  gsub(pattern="-", replacement="_", gdatw$pop)

# write_delim(mutate(gdatw, ID=paste0("i", ID)), col_names=FALSE, file="../admixture/gdatw2.ped", na="0")

# data.frame(Chromosome=1, SNP=paste0("rs", 10001:10252), GD=0, POS=seq(1, 252000000, 1000000)) |> 
#   write_delim(col_names=FALSE, file="../admixture/gdatw2.map")
```



```{zsh, eval=FALSE}

cd /Users/tylermccraney/Google\ Drive/My\ Drive/Puyallup-White/admixture

plink --file gdatw2 --make-bed --out gdatw2

for K in 1 2 3 4; do admixture -s $RANDOM --cv=10 gdatw2.bed $K | tee gdatw2_log${K}.out; done

grep -h CV gdatw2_log* > gdatw2_log.txt
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
gdatw_cv <- 
  read_delim("../admixture/gdatw2_log.txt", col_names=FALSE) %>% 
  mutate(K=1:nrow(.)) |> 
  select(K, CV_error=X4)

plot(gdatw_cv); lines(gdatw_cv)

```


```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=13, fig.height=3}
tbl2 <- read.table("../admixture/gdatw2.2.Q")

tbl3 <- read.table("../admixture/gdatw2.3.Q")

gdatw_pop <- 
  gsub(pattern="River", replacement="R", gdatw$pop) |> 
  gsub(pattern="Creek", replacement="C") |> 
  gsub(pattern="Hatchery", replacement="H") |> 
  gsub(pattern="Chinook_", replacement="") |> 
  gsub(pattern="Buckley_Trap_", replacement="") |> 
  gsub(pattern="at_", replacement="_") |> 
  gsub(pattern="unclipped", replacement="Fall") |>
  gsub(pattern="_PBT", replacement="Fall") |>
  gsub(pattern="WDFW_FH", replacement="Fall") |>
  gsub(pattern="Spring_Fall_06KK", replacement="Spring_06KK_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="R_24ND", replacement="R_Spring_24ND_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="R_25NI", replacement="R_Spring_25NI_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="fall", replacement="Fall") |>
  gsub(pattern="08HZ", replacement="08HZ_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="98HB", replacement="98HB_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="10JX", replacement="10JX_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="12IP", replacement="12IP_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="__", replacement="_") |>
  gsub(pattern="Hupp_Springs_23LQ", replacement="Hupp_S_Spring_23LQ_Baseline") |>
  gsub(pattern="Minter_C_23LR", replacement="Minter_C_Fall_23LR_Baseline")

rownames(tbl2) <- 
  gdatw$ID

rownames(tbl3) <- 
  gdatw$ID

tbl2$pop <- 
  gdatw_pop

tbl3$pop <- 
  gdatw_pop

tbl2 <- 
  bind_rows(tbl2, tibble(V1=rep(NA, 4), V2=rep(NA, 4), pop=rep(NA, 4)))

tbl3 <- 
  bind_rows(tbl3, tibble(V1=rep(NA, 4), V2=rep(NA, 4), V3=rep(NA, 4), pop=rep(NA, 4)))

rownames(tbl2)[1317:1320] <- 
  paste0("spacer", 1:4)

rownames(tbl3)[1317:1320] <- 
  paste0("spacer", 1:4)

tbl2 <- 
  tbl2[rownames(tbl2)[c(1:225, 1317, 226:966, 1318, 967:1002, 1319, 1003:1060, 1320, 1061:1316)], ]

tbl3 <- 
  tbl3[rownames(tbl3)[c(1:225, 1317, 226:966, 1318, 967:1002, 1319, 1003:1060, 1320, 1061:1316)], ]


# pdf("../admixture/gdatw2_k2_3.pdf", width=13, height=6)
# par(mar=c(7, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1, mfrow=c(2, 1))
par(mar=c(7, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)
barplot(t(as.matrix(tbl2[-3])), col=hcl.colors(3)[-2], ylab="Ancestry", border=NA, names.arg=tbl2$pop, las=2, cex.names=0.3, space=0, main=expression(italic(K)==2*`*`), font.main=1)
abline(v=c(226, 968, 1005, 1064), col="white")
mtext(text="Baseline Spring", adj=0.08)
mtext(text="'Spring'")
mtext(text="?", adj=0.73)
mtext(text="'Fall'", adj=0.77)
mtext(text="Baseline Fall", adj=0.90)

```

#### Interpretation of mixed-color barplots

#### Classify fish as 'Spring', 'Fall', or 'Hybrid' based on their proportional ancestry  

Sort fish by their _Spring_ ancestry. The 'Fall' class is defined by 0.0-0.4 _Spring_ ancestry, the 'Hybrid' class by 0.6-0.6 _Spring_ ancestry, and the 'Spring' class by 0.6-1.0 _Spring_ ancestry.   

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=13, fig.height=3}
tbl2s <- 
  arrange(tbl2, desc(V1)) |>
  mutate(
    ASSIGNMENT=ifelse(grepl("_Spring_", pop), yes="Spring", no=NA), 
    ASSIGNMENT=ifelse(grepl("_Unknown_", pop), yes="Unknown", no=ASSIGNMENT), 
    ASSIGNMENT=ifelse(grepl("_Fall_", pop), yes="Fall", no=ASSIGNMENT), 
    BASELINE=ifelse(grepl("_Baseline", pop), yes=TRUE, no=FALSE),
    Q=cut(V1, breaks=c(0, 0.4, 0.6, 1)))

tbl2s$Q <- 
  factor(
    tbl2s$Q, 
    levels=c("(0.6,1]", "(0.4,0.6]", "(0,0.4]"), 
    labels=c("Spring", "Hybrid", "Fall"), 
    ordered=TRUE)

tbl2s$ASSIGNMENT <- 
  factor(
    tbl2s$ASSIGNMENT, 
    levels=c("Spring", "Unknown", "Fall"), 
    ordered=TRUE)

# pdf("../admixture/gdatw2_k2_sorted.pdf", width=13, height=3)
par(mar=c(7, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)
barplot(t(as.matrix(tbl2s[1:2])), col=hcl.colors(3)[-2], ylab="Ancestry", border=NA, names.arg=tbl2s$pop, las=2, cex.names=0.3, space=0, main=expression(italic(K)==2*`*`), font.main=1)
# abline(h=0.5, v=1026, col="white", lty=3)
abline(h=c(0.4, 0.6), v=c(953, 1062), , col="white")
mtext(text="'Spring'", adj=0.37)
mtext(text="'Hybrid'", adj=0.76)
mtext(text="'Fall'", adj=0.87)
# dev.off()
```

#### Ancestry classification of 100% baseline samples

Baseline reporting groups (in rows) assigned to 'Spring', 'Fall', or 'Hybrid' ancestry classes (in columns). The 'Fall' class is defined by 0.0-0.4 _Spring_ ancestry, the 'Hybrid' class by 0.6-0.6 _Spring_ ancestry, and the 'Spring' class by 0.6-1.0 _Spring_ ancestry.   

```{r, echo=FALSE}
table(filter(tbl2s, BASELINE==TRUE)$ASSIGNMENT, filter(tbl2s, BASELINE==TRUE)$Q)[-2, ]
```

#### Ancestry classification of 100% WRS NORs

White River NOR assignments (in rows) assigned to 'Spring', 'Fall', or 'Hybrid' ancestry classes (in columns). The 'Fall' class is defined by 0.0-0.4 _Spring_ ancestry, the 'Hybrid' class by 0.6-0.6 _Spring_ ancestry, and the 'Spring' class by 0.6-1.0 _Spring_ ancestry.   
      

```{r, echo=FALSE}
table(filter(tbl2s, BASELINE==FALSE)$ASSIGNMENT, filter(tbl2s, BASELINE==FALSE)$Q)
```
